text:
```artifact
Feature: Alarms in GUI

  Scenario Outline: Compute and display LOW VTI alarm
    Given the VTI threshold is set to <threshold>
    And the current VTI is <vti>
    When the GUI computes the VTI for the current breath
    Then the GUI should display a "LOW VTI" alarm if <vti> is above <threshold>
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

    Examples:
      | threshold | vti |
      | 10        | 15  |
      | 20        | 25  |
      | 30        | 35  |

  Scenario Outline: Compute and display HIGH VTI alarm
    Given the VTI threshold is set to <threshold>
    And the current VTI is <vti>
    When the GUI computes the VTI for the current breath
    Then the GUI should display a "HIGH VTI" alarm if <vti> is above <threshold>
    And the alarm should be of medium priority

    Examples:
      | threshold | vti |
      | 10        | 15  |
      | 20        | 25  |
      | 30        | 35  |

  Scenario Outline: Compute and display LOW VTE alarm
    Given the VTE threshold is set to <threshold>
    And the current VTE is <vte>
    When the GUI computes the VTE for the current breath
    Then the GUI should display a "LOW VTE" alarm if <vte> is above <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold | vte |
      | 10        | 15  |
      | 20        | 25  |
      | 30        | 35  |

  Scenario Outline: Set and validate VTI threshold
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the VTI threshold to <threshold>
    Then the GUI should display the new threshold value as <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 10        |
      | 20        |
      | 30        |

  Scenario Outline: Set and validate VTE threshold
    Given the GUI is open
    When the user sets the VTE threshold to <threshold>
    Then the GUI should display the new threshold value as <threshold>

    Examples:
      | threshold |
      | 10        |
      | 20        |
      | 30        |
```
